Model questions

R4EFL5T FAQ

What is the rated capacity of the R4EFL5T?

The stated rated capacity is 5,000 kg. Final suitability depends on load center, lift height, attachment, and operating conditions.

What is the lift specification of the R4EFL5T?

The listed lift specification is 3,000 mm. Confirm the required maximum height and residual capacity before ordering.

What information is needed to quote the R4EFL5T?

Provide load weight and dimensions, lift height, aisle or route conditions, daily duty, battery requirement, quantity, and destination.
